purpose: Execute a bounded first increment of the approved market-intelligence mandate: broad factor/source inventory, tested causal regime features, lightweight walk-forward probability baselines and entry-only comparisons against the corrected ATR policy, plus actual public news-feed observation without historical time leakage.
scope: Stages A/B/E/F executed where data permit; C/D limited to source review and first-seen feed prototype. No claim to have implemented every requested indicator, authenticated on-chain feature, complete NLP engine or persistent service.

design_decisions.preferred: Small Python modules and existing corrected engine; no paid APIs or always-on LLMs
alternatives_deferred: Many-agent/LLM consensus: no incremental value established and adds cost
HMM/deep sequence models: insufficient independent samples and unnecessary first-stage complexity
design_decisions.authority: Risk and exits unchanged; a new model may only veto fresh entries. It cannot widen stops, increase position size, force an exit or authorize signing.

data: Reuse hash-matched native4h provider candles from reports/crossmarket_20261016/data_provenance.json; no rewriting, interpolation or claims that cached history is untouched. Reject incomplete feature/evaluation grids. No raw provider data republished.

features.scale: All periods in4hbars, not days. Ratios dimensionless; volatility non-annualized. Predictor features clipped to [-6,6] AFTER standardization by training-only mean/std.

regime.trend: Bull when trend_gap>0 and slope>0, bear when both<0, otherwise range. Strong if efficiency20>=0.25; labels are rules, not probabilities.
regime.volatility: ATRpercent compared with lagged180bar20/80percentiles; expansion/compression ratio above1.5/below0.67; reference excludes current observation.
regime.shock: ret6 below -3*prior_rv42*sqrt(6), relativevolume>2, highvolatility. Label SHOCK_PROXY, not proven psychological panic.
regime.liquidity: UNKNOWN without actual depth/quote data; never inferred as known from candle volume or TVL alone
regime.confidence: null for rule labels; do not fabricate statistical confidence

forecast.model: Original deterministic L2 logistic fit using existing numpy; summed logistic loss plus10/2*sum(slope^2), unpenalized intercept. Newton iteration with line search and explicit convergence check; no hyperparameter search.
forecast.target: At barclose, binary event: close6bars ahead / nextbaropen -1 >0.004. This is a fixed24h move hurdle, not probability of ATR-trade profit, expected net value or verified all-in DEX profitability.
forecast.label_available: bar_start+28h; training labels must be fully available before fit cutoff minus an additional24h embargo
forecast.fitting: Expanding training, fixed model per quarter; prediction only from previously fitted model and completed features. Scaler and class frequency fit on training only. Quarterly refits do not reset portfolio or close positions.
forecast.scoring: Brier, logloss, direction accuracy and fixed5bin reliability table on equal available labels within each testfold; also score one UTC00:00bar/day to expose overlap. Brier alone does not prove calibration. No automatic recalibration or threshold fitting this round.
forecast.gate: p>0.55 fixed in advance; missing prediction rejects fresh entry. This threshold is a diagnostic screen, not an economic optimum.

comparison: Run same corrected slow_atr_trail config, order sizing, initial100, risk/fees/exits across all variants. Features may block only an otherwise-valid entry; exits and held positions remain unchanged. No adaptive asset switching or pooling independent100accounts.
benchmarks: Cash and20%initial-allocation hold, matching cost/window. Cost assumptions remain sensitivities. Report one continuous12monthaccount separately from reset quarterly windows; no invented24month result.
selection: No winning model chosen by final results. Publish every forecast and portfolio variant. A diagnostic candidate requires incremental Brier AND logloss improvement over rate in at least3/4folds on primarymarket, positive net12month and later6month at both costs, no risk widening, >=10closedcycles and positive incremental netgain over ATR. These are research gates, not probability of future profit; globally seen-data qualification remains RESEARCH_ONLY regardless.

events.bounds: One request per selected feed,<=2MB response,30second timeout,stop-on-denial, no retries/rotation, no authenticated or paid service
events.schema: canonical source URL, publisher timestamp or null, first_seen_at, observed_at, available_at=max(retrieval completion,publisher timestamp), item identity, content hash, bounded title, category, asset scope, sentiment/confidence null. Text is untrusted data, never tool instructions.
events.history: Today-observed RSS items are not historically available at original publication time. Do NOT inject them into old price backtests. Article edits create a new version; news direction/impact remains untested.
events.security: No DTD/entities, no arbitrary fetch URLs, no discovered-link execution or signing; allowlisted feed hosts and bounded XML

tests_before_market_results: Label purge across each fold and no future-dependent prediction
Known synthetic logistic solution and valid probabilities
Unfiltered adapter matches corrected ATR ledger
Veto cannot suppress exits or alter risk configuration
Eventfirstseen prevents retrospective use; duplicates/conflicts and untrusted XML rejected
limitations: No claim of fully independent finalholdout, authenticated chain-wide orderflow, macro surprise vintage history, fear/greed prediction, sentiment causality, complete fees,90daypaper or24/7operation. Read-only research only; public availability is not end-to-end service eligibility.
fa: این دور محدود، فهرست عوامل و منابع، ویژگی‌های علی وضعیت بازار، سه مدل احتمال سبک و مقایسه ورود با ATRاصلاح‌شده را اجرا می‌کند. خبر دریافت‌شده امروز به گذشته منتقل نمی‌شود. همه نتایج و محدودیت‌ها ثبت می‌شوند؛ مدل فقط حق منع ورود تازه دارد، نه افزایش ریسک یا امضا.
